name: zSentinel · Vliegende keep
goal: Finish already-open product PRs on main with the existing CI/review/ownership gates, then restore stalled workers and blocked delivery routes across canonical projects without displacing active claims.
next_step: Start with existing open product PRs: inspect exact-head required CI, independent review and any conflicts; merge only with an authorized live exclusive mainwriter lease, GitHub permission and verified default-branch commit. For HOLD or unknown-owner work, run the read-only scripts/zsentinel_issue_first_board.py --project cloud (plus up to two independent canonical projects) to prioritize open P0/P1 issues already referenced by existing non-QA PRs. For a known P0/P1 issue missed by the recent 100-PR window use --project cloud --issue <existing number>, and follow --candidate-page 2..50 only while source coverage remains partial. For up to three sequential pages in one bounded run, add --auto-pages 2..3; this never proves atomic or complete GitHub Search and --snapshot-output is single-page only. If a page stops after four PR matches or runs out of source budget, do NOT skip the unread candidates by going to page N+1: resume page N with the observed --candidate-offset and exact --expected-page-sha, or restart from offset zero if GitHub Search order changed. Offset resumes cannot use --snapshot-output. The private read-only claim panel may display local active lease totals but NEVER proves Notion or other worker ownership is absent; inspect current external claims before writing. Never create a duplicate new PR from an incomplete search window. Treat PR-body references as hints, never proof of a fix or owner vacancy; inspect active Notion/queue claims before touching a task. Repair real CI/conflicts or safely deliver another freely owned P0/P1 fix; never start new QA suites, bypass security/release gates or deploy without owner authority.

milestones.title: Deliver owned product PRs and restore blocked project execution
